narration: For {identical_months} months the two lives were exactly the same. In month {fork_month} you chose {real_choice}, and the ghost took {ghost_choice}. In month {first_bar_apart_month}, {first_bar_apart} was the first score to part, with a share of the ghost's salary pledged away each month. At the layoff in month {layoff_month}, the ghost had {layoff_net_worth_gap}. By month {end_month} the ghost had {net_worth_gap}. Its Freedom ended at {ghost_freedom}, nearly all of its pay claimed before it arrived.
